name: aether
description: Aether — voice-first personal agent with its own computer, email and phone. iPhone/iPad first.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/core & npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/core
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/core && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/core && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
